 "data": "@startuml
skinparam roundcorner 10
skinparam linetype ortho
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor White
 ArrowColor #2c3e50
 BorderColor #2c3e50
}

' ================= User Domain (Blue) =================
entity \"USER\" as USER #E3F2FD {
 * _id : ObjectId <<PK>>
 --
 * username : String
 * email : String <<unique>>
 * password : String
 phone : String
 avatar : String
 role : Enum
 isVerified : Boolean
 resetPasswordToken : String
 resetPasswordExpire : Date
 createdAt : Date
 updatedAt : Date
}

entity \"ADDRESS (Embedded)\" as ADDRESS #BBDEFB {
 --
 fullName : String
 phone : String
 country : String
 city : String
 address : String
 postalCode : String
}

entity \"OTP\" as OTP #E3F2FD {
 * _id : ObjectId <<PK>>
 --
 * email : String
 * otp : String
 * expiresAt : Date <<TTL>>
 userData : Object
 createdAt : Date
}

' ================= Product Domain (Green) =================
entity \"PRODUCT\" as PRODUCT #E8F5E9 {
 * _id : ObjectId <<PK>>
 --
 * name : String
 * slug : String <<unique>>
 * shortDescription : String
 * description : String
 * price : Number
 discountPrice : Number
 stock : Number
 sku : String <<unique>>
 * category : String <<indexed>>
 subcategory : String
 brand : String <<indexed>>
 tags : String[]
 averageRating : Number
 numReviews : Number
 featured : Boolean
 isActive : Boolean
 * createdBy : ObjectId <<FK>>
 createdAt : Date
 updatedAt : Date
}

entity \"IMAGE (Embedded)\" as IMAGE #C8E6C9 {
 --
 * public_id : String
 * url : String
}

entity \"REVIEW (Embedded)\" as REVIEW #C8E6C9 {
 --
 * user : ObjectId <<FK>>
 * username : String
 * rating : Number
 comment : String
 createdAt : Date
}

' ================= Cart Domain (Orange) =================
entity \"CART\" as CART #FFF3E0 {
 * _id : ObjectId <<PK>>
 --
 * user : ObjectId <<FK>>
 subtotal : Number <<Virtual>>
 discountAmount : Number <<Virtual>>
 total : Number <<Virtual>>
 itemCount : Number <<Virtual>>
 createdAt : Date
 updatedAt : Date
}

entity \"CART_ITEM (Embedded)\" as CART_ITEM #FFE0B2 {
 --
 * product : ObjectId <<FK>>
 * name : String
 * image : String
 * price : Number
 * quantity : Number
}

entity \"COUPON (Embedded)\" as COUPON #FFE0B2 {
 --
 code : String
 discountType : Enum
 discountValue : Number
}

' ================= Order Domain (Purple) =================
entity \"ORDER\" as ORDER #F3E5F5 {
 * _id : ObjectId <<PK>>
 --
 * user : ObjectId <<FK>>
 paymentMethod : Enum
 paymentStatus : Enum
 transactionId : String
 * subtotal : Number
 shippingFee : Number
 tax : Number
 discount : Number
 * totalPrice : Number
 status : Enum
 paidAt : Date
 deliveredAt : Date
 customerNote : String
 adminNote : String
 createdAt : Date
}

entity \"ORDER_ITEM (Embedded)\" as ORDER_ITEM #E1BEE7 {
 --
 * name : String
 * image : String
 * price : Number
 * quantity : Number
}

entity \"SHIPPING_ADDRESS (Embedded)\" as SHIPPING_ADDRESS #E1BEE7 {
 --
 * fullName : String
 * phone : String
 * country : String
 * city : String
 * address : String
 * postalCode : String
}

' ================= Wishlist Domain (Pink) =================
entity \"WISHLIST\" as WISHLIST #FCE4EC {
 * _id : ObjectId <<PK>>
 --
 * user : ObjectId <<FK>>
 products : ObjectId[] <<Refs>>
 createdAt : Date
 updatedAt : Date
}

' ================= Relationships =================

' Core Relations
USER ||--o{ PRODUCT : \"createdBy\"
USER ||--o| CART : \"has\"
USER ||--o{ ORDER : \"places\"
USER ||--o| WISHLIST : \"owns\"

' Embedded Relations
USER *--o{ ADDRESS : \"addresses\"
PRODUCT *--o{ IMAGE : \"images\"
PRODUCT *--o{ REVIEW : \"reviews\"
CART *--o{ CART_ITEM : \"items\"
CART *--o| COUPON : \"coupon\"
ORDER *--o{ ORDER_ITEM : \"items\"
ORDER *--o| SHIPPING_ADDRESS : \"shippingAddress\"

' External References (Populations)
PRODUCT ||--o{ CART_ITEM : \"ref\"
PRODUCT }o--o{ WISHLIST : \"ref\"
USER ||--o{ REVIEW : \"ref\"
